content: CHECKPOINT (security, opus, 0.86) on scripts/goal_loop.py. Deterministic core SOUND: green-only-via-verify is structurally enforced (no path sets green from prose); fail-closed L2 seam correct; goal-met re-verify is real; integrity hash canonical (sort_keys, excludes itself); atomic temp+rename write; injection-free subprocess (shlex + no shell=True, yaml.safe_load, secrets nonce); PendingModelInvoker raises (fail-closed). BLOCKING F1 HIGH: R7 untrusted-on-read is UNWIRED -- reconstruct() defined (line 466) but has ZERO call sites; run_goal_loop trusts resumed greens; the integrity hash is attacker-recomputable (pure public fn over file contents) so it only catches TORN writes, not tampering; the re-derivation in reconstruct is the real tamper defense and it is dead code; AC8-neg fails. Fix: call reconstruct() after read_loop_state when state loaded from disk, sourcing checker_verified_green from the append-only discussion events. F2 MED: tamper tripwire misses non-.py / non-slashed verify scripts (bash check.sh, make verify) + tox.ini/setup.cfg + --cov-fail-under flags. F3 MED: the per-green content anchor is stored but never re-checked (decorative) -- greens have no mid-run staleness detection, only at goal-met. F4 LOW: LoopStateIntegrityError propagates UNCAUGHT from run_goal_loop -> should PARK with a report, not crash. F5 LOW: verify_command_targets uses str.split not shlex.split (quoted-path evasion). The core is right; the headline R7 control just needs wiring.

CHECKPOINT (qa, 0.87) on scripts/goal_loop.py. Seam architecture EXCELLENT for testability (all model/gate/diff/auth behind injected Protocols, no globals); net-progress is oscillation-proof (verified -- uses max(history), a red<->green flip cannot reset the counter unless total green rises); validate_contract enforces all 3 R5.3 rules; atomic os.replace; integrity excludes itself (no hash-of-hash). BLOCKING F5 HIGH (convergent with security): reconstruct() is never called from run_goal_loop -> AC8-neg untestable; checker_verified_green wiring is the open gap. F11 MED->BLOCKING AC10: per-tick auth.affirm_l2 re-check is ABSENT; the `autonomy` var is set but never used again; revoked-mid-run -> park is NOT implemented. F2 HIGH: GOAL_MET re-verify path does not increment iteration and can spend judge tokens without a guard; cap the re-verify and do not commit partial state if budget exceeded during re-verify. F3 HIGH: _tick_context KeyErrors if state.criteria is not fully initialized (a unit-test construction hazard). F7 MED: the tripwire does not protect scripts/goal_loop.py itself (the driver IS part of the verifier surface). F8 MED: AC3 needs JudgeResult.agent_id (verified_by is a label, not an id) to assert builder != checker distinct id. F9 LOW: duplicate criterion id is not validated (aliasing -> undercount -> never goal_met). F10 LOW: unknown no_progress_definition silently falls back (should fail loud in validate). F12 MED: re-verify passes an empty Diff to the judge -- semantics unclear (full-state vs delta). F1/F6: document the conservative no_progress on the tamper-reject branch + the budget-overshoot-by-one-tick. Blocking for T8: wire reconstruct (F5), per-tick auth (F11), dup-id (F9).
